cases.purpose: bashkmod load/unload of the real nbd module: Live in /proc/modules, parameters visible in sysfs, list agrees with lsmod, EEXIST/ENOENT/EBUSY diagnostics, state restored
cases.oracle: kmod (modprobe/rmmod/lsmod/modinfo, util-linux-independent) in the guest kernel 6.12 cloud image, plus /proc/modules and /sys/module read directly
cases.comparison: Oracle kmod modprobe/modprobe -r establish the expected state of the same module; the candidate load of the decompressed .ko, its list row against lsmod, error texts and the restored module set are asserted.
cases.script:
[[ $UID == 0 && $EUID == 0 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
[[ $(type -t bashkmod) == builtin ]] || exit 125
has() { local n; while read -r n _; do [[ $n == "$1" ]] && return 0; done </proc/modules; return 1; }
names() { local n out=; while read -r n _; do out="$out $n"; done </proc/modules; echo "$out"; }
b() { "$@" && echo 1 || echo 0; }
/usr/bin/python3 -I - <<'PY'
import glob, lzma
src = glob.glob('/lib/modules/*/kernel/drivers/block/nbd.ko.xz')[0]
open('/tmp/parity-case/nbd.ko', 'wb').write(lzma.open(src).read())
PY
KO=/tmp/parity-case/nbd.ko
base=$(names)
echo "before: nbd-loaded=$(b has nbd)"
/usr/sbin/modprobe nbd nbds_max=4 max_part=2; rc=$?; read -r st </sys/module/nbd/initstate; read -r nm </sys/module/nbd/parameters/nbds_max; read -r omp </sys/module/nbd/parameters/max_part
echo "oracle modprobe: rc=$rc loaded=$(b has nbd) initstate=$st nbds_max=$nm"
/usr/sbin/modprobe -r nbd; echo "oracle modprobe -r: rc=$? loaded=$(b has nbd)"
bashkmod load "$KO" nbds_max=4 max_part=2; rc=$?
read -r st </sys/module/nbd/initstate; read -r nm </sys/module/nbd/parameters/nbds_max; read -r mp </sys/module/nbd/parameters/max_part
state=; while read -r n sz ref deps s _; do [[ $n == nbd ]] && state=$s; done </proc/modules
echo "candidate load: rc=$rc loaded=$(b has nbd) initstate=$st proc-state=$state nbds_max=$nm max_part-equals-oracle=$([[ $mp == "$omp" ]] && echo 1 || echo 0)"
row=; while read -r n sz ref deps s; do [[ $n == nbd ]] && row="$sz $ref"; done < <(bashkmod list)
lrow=; while read -r n sz ref rest; do [[ $n == nbd ]] && lrow="$sz $ref"; done < <(/usr/sbin/lsmod)
echo "list-row-equals-lsmod=$([[ -n $row && $row == "$lrow" ]] && echo 1 || echo 0)"
out=$(bashkmod load "$KO" 2>&1); echo "reload: rc=$? text=$([[ $out == *"File exists"* ]] && echo 1 || echo 0)"
bashkmod unload nbd; echo "unload: rc=$? loaded=$(b has nbd)"
out=$(bashkmod unload nbd 2>&1); echo "unload-again: rc=$? text=$([[ $out == *"no such module"* ]] && echo 1 || echo 0)"
/usr/sbin/modprobe ip_set; echo "oracle ip_set: rc=$? loaded=$(b has ip_set)"
out=$(bashkmod unload nfnetlink 2>&1); echo "unload-busy: rc=$? text=$([[ $out == *"module in use"* ]] && echo 1 || echo 0) still-loaded=$(b has nfnetlink)"
bashkmod unload ip_set; echo "unload ip_set: rc=$? loaded=$(b has ip_set)"
echo "restored: $([[ $(names) == "$base" ]] && echo 1 || echo 0)"
cases.stdout:
before: nbd-loaded=0
oracle modprobe: rc=0 loaded=1 initstate=live nbds_max=4
oracle modprobe -r: rc=0 loaded=0
candidate load: rc=0 loaded=1 initstate=live proc-state=Live nbds_max=4 max_part-equals-oracle=1
list-row-equals-lsmod=1
reload: rc=1 text=1
unload: rc=0 loaded=0
unload-again: rc=1 text=1
oracle ip_set: rc=0 loaded=1
unload-busy: rc=1 text=1 still-loaded=1
unload ip_set: rc=0 loaded=0
restored: 1

cases.purpose: Non-dry bashkmod modprobe loads the modules.dep chain deepest-first and the final module with PARAMS; modprobe -r removes the chain in reverse
cases.oracle: kmod (modprobe/rmmod/lsmod/modinfo, util-linux-independent) in the guest kernel 6.12 cloud image, plus /proc/modules and /sys/module read directly
cases.comparison: kmod's modprobe -n -v plan gives the expected load order; the candidate's resulting /proc/modules additions, parameters and removal are compared.
cases.script:
[[ $UID == 0 && $EUID == 0 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
[[ $(type -t bashkmod) == builtin ]] || exit 125
has() { local n; while read -r n _; do [[ $n == "$1" ]] && return 0; done </proc/modules; return 1; }
names() { local n out=; while read -r n _; do out="$out $n"; done </proc/modules; echo "$out"; }
b() { "$@" && echo 1 || echo 0; }
base=$(names)
plan=$(/usr/sbin/modprobe -n -v br_netfilter 2>&1); order=
while read -r l; do [[ $l == insmod* ]] || continue; n=${l##*/}; n=${n%%.ko*}; order="$order ${n//-/_}"; done <<<"$plan"
echo "oracle plan nonempty=$([[ -n $order ]] && echo 1 || echo 0)"
out=$(bashkmod modprobe nbd nbds_max=4 2>&1); rc=$?
read -r nm </sys/module/nbd/parameters/nbds_max 2>/dev/null
echo "modprobe nbd: rc=$rc loaded=$(b has nbd) nbds_max=${nm:-none}"
/usr/sbin/rmmod nbd 2>/dev/null
out=$(bashkmod modprobe br_netfilter 2>&1); rc=$?
new=; for n in $(names); do [[ " $base " == *" $n "* ]] || new="$new $n"; done
echo "modprobe br_netfilter: rc=$rc loaded-in-kmod-plan-order=$([[ "$new" == "$order" ]] && echo 1 || echo 0)"
out=$(bashkmod modprobe -r br_netfilter 2>&1); echo "modprobe -r: rc=$? back-to-base=$([[ $(names) == "$base" ]] && echo 1 || echo 0)"
/usr/sbin/modprobe -r br_netfilter 2>/dev/null
cases.stdout:
oracle plan nonempty=1
modprobe nbd: rc=0 loaded=1 nbds_max=4
modprobe br_netfilter: rc=0 loaded-in-kmod-plan-order=1
modprobe -r: rc=0 back-to-base=1

cases.purpose: Without CAP_SYS_MODULE load maps EPERM to 'need CAP_SYS_MODULE' with status 2 and unload reports it with status 1
cases.oracle: The kernel's capability check for finit_module/delete_module as uid 2000, and the builtin's documented errno mapping
cases.comparison: Status and diagnostic text for load and unload as an unprivileged user.
cases.script:
[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
[[ $(type -t bashkmod) == builtin ]] || exit 125
/usr/bin/python3 -I -c "open('/tmp/parity-case/x.ko','wb').close()"
out=$(bashkmod load /tmp/parity-case/x.ko 2>&1); echo "load: rc=$? text=$([[ $out == *"need CAP_SYS_MODULE"* ]] && echo 1 || echo 0)"
out=$(bashkmod unload nbd 2>&1); echo "unload: rc=$? text=$([[ $out == *"need CAP_SYS_MODULE"* ]] && echo 1 || echo 0)"
cases.stdout:
load: rc=2 text=1
unload: rc=1 text=1
